authority.summary: Replace the exhausted inline YAML detect-secrets post-processing strategy with a dedicated project-local CI helper script that ignores only canonical Project Leader SHA metadata findings while preserving failure for every other finding. Restore both workflows to minimal scan commands and complete WireGuard 004B CI validation.

required_validation: Inline YAML scanner post-processing is removed from both workflows
The helper ignores only Hex High Entropy String findings on canonical .project-leader JSON SHA metadata fields with exact lowercase 40- or 64-character hexadecimal values
Every other detect-secrets finding remains fatal
The helper file itself remains inside repository scanning and no .project-leader directory-wide exclusion is introduced
Android CI and Backend CI both succeed on the same implementation head
WireGuard API24 smoke remains bounded and succeeds
terminal_condition: Both required workflows succeed on the same implementation head; the dedicated scan helper passes while preserving all non-metadata findings as fatal; API24 smoke succeeds; Supervisor verifies task-local scope and WireGuard 004B non-effects; merge remains a Human Gate.
